title: Noor and the Ledger
author: Ulyana Oyelaran
blurb: Kestrel Ravensworth, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
